Deploy Plone in minutes: now on Linode, AWS, DigitalOcean & Hetzner. 🚀

Join Karel, TKim and others in a 30-min YouTube livestream on Friday, Nov 20 at 14:30 UTC for a live demo & dev discussion on Plone in a Box. Bring your questions! 💡  Bring your timers ⏱️ 

As presenter TKim Nguyen says "this is meant for non-technical people, no need for a command line: just clicky clicky"

but... technical people are also welcome 🩵 

Watch live: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wVKhNCRwjo4 

#Plone #OpenSource #DevOps #TuneUp
